manifest_row.title: Our fight to the death with nature is not one we can win

screening.main_topic: An opinion essay on humanity’s relationship with nature, ecological exploitation, and the idea of escaping Earth through space colonisation.
screening.climate_relevance: Climate change is used as a meaningful example of human-caused ecological damage and of how religious or technological escape fantasies can encourage disregard for environmental consequences.
screening.reason: The essay explicitly connects fossil-fuel use and climate change to the destruction of natural populations, and discusses climate denial as part of a broader argument about humanity’s treatment of Earth. However, its main focus is the human relationship with nature and the limits of space-based refuges, rather than climate change itself.
